svg.title: Resonator half-trace stability and Gaussian eigenmode
svg.desc: The left panel marks unstable, stable, and marginal regions on the matrix half-trace axis. The right panel shows a Gaussian mode fitted between two curved mirrors and the fixed-point ABCD relation.
